name: QAM - Scheduled Sprint Summary (Lab Starter)

nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Set to every 15 min for the lab exercise only. In real use, daily or weekly is more appropriate for a status report — discuss cadence with participants in B2.

nodes.name: Get Sprint & Defect Issues
nodes.notes: Attach a credential for YOUR OWN Jira project (the same one you queried via MCP in Part A). The JQL below ships as a placeholder (project QAM, Sprint 15) — replace both the project key and sprint name with your real ones before running this node.

nodes.name: Format Issues For Prompt
nodes.notes: Reduces the raw Jira issue array into a compact text block so the AI Summary node's prompt stays small. Participants edit the sections requested in step B3, not this node — but it's worth reading once. FACILITATOR: this hardcodes customfield_10016 for Story Points — confirm that's the real field ID on your sandbox after import (see sample-data/import-instructions.md step 5) before the session; if wrong it just shows 'n/a' silently, no crash.

nodes.name: OpenAI Chat Model
nodes.notes: The model sub-node feeding 'AI Summary' below (connected via the special Model input, not a regular data link). Swap the credential for whatever LLM provider your org standardizes on if not OpenAI — there are equivalent Chat Model nodes for Anthropic, Gemini, etc. in the same panel.

nodes.name: AI Summary
nodes.notes: Placeholder prompt — replace with the four-section structure from Part A (velocity, defect density, backlog health, risk flag) as instructed in lab-guide.md step B3. Output lands in $json.text on the item this node emits — confirm that by pinning/running the node once before wiring the Send Email step.

parameters.text:
=REPLACE THIS PROMPT (see lab-guide.md step B3): raw issue data below.

{{ $json.summaryText }}

messageValues.message: You are an assistant drafting an advisory sprint status summary for a Test Manager. Only use information present in the issue data provided — never invent details. Flag anything uncertain.

nodes.name: Send Email
nodes.notes: Use the dedicated training mailbox's SMTP credential from 00-setup/setup-guide.md — never a personal or production account. Set 'toEmail' to your own address for the B4 test run.

_scaffoldNotice: Hand-authored, but node types/versions/parameter shapes verified against a live n8n 2.35.3 container's own node registry (n8n export:nodes) and a successful `n8n import:workflow` — see facilitator-notes.md for what 'verified' does and doesn't cover here (credentials are still placeholders; nobody has run this end-to-end with real Jira/OpenAI/SMTP creds yet).
